title: Mega Menu
description: Store navigation whose flyouts span the bar's full width, for link columns and featured tiles; panels slide between categories and the height follows.

components.MegaMenu: Groups all parts of the mega menu.
components.MegaMenuContent: Holds the links and content shown when its menu item is open.
components.MegaMenuItem: Groups a trigger with the content it opens in the mega menu.
components.MegaMenuLink: Links to a page from inside the mega menu.
components.MegaMenuList: Lists the top-level items of the mega menu.
components.MegaMenuTrigger: Opens and closes the content of its mega menu item.
components.MegaMenuViewport: Shows the content of the open mega menu item.
